# TestYieldFactory
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/rwa-oracles/src/test-yield/TestYieldFactory.sol)

**Inherits:**
Ownable

**Title:**
TestYieldFactory

**Author:**
Summer

Factory for deploying and managing TestYieldToken contracts per ticker.

Owner is the deployer. Factory owns all deployed tokens and can process deposits/withdrawals.


## State Variables
### tickers
Ticker symbol => TestYieldToken address


```solidity
mapping(string => address) public tickers
```


### allTickers
Array of all deployed token addresses


```solidity
address[] public allTickers
```


### addressToTicker
Token address => ticker (reverse lookup)


```solidity
mapping(address => string) public addressToTicker
```


## Functions
### constructor


```solidity
constructor(address _owner) Ownable(_owner);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_owner`|`address`|Owner address (deployer)|


### deployYieldToken

Deploy a new TestYieldToken for a ticker.

Reverts if ticker already exists. Factory becomes owner of the token.


```solidity
function deployYieldToken(
    string memory name,
    string memory ticker,
    address usdc,
    address oracle
)
    external
    onlyOwner
    returns (address);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`name`|`string`|ERC20 name (e.g. "Test Yield SPXUX")|
|`ticker`|`string`|Ticker symbol (e.g. "SPXUX")|
|`usdc`|`address`|USDC token address|
|`oracle`|`address`|Price oracle address|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|Address of the deployed TestYieldToken|


### getAllTickers

Get all deployed token addresses.


```solidity
function getAllTickers() external view returns (address[] memory);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address[]`|Array of TestYieldToken addresses.|


### processDeposit

Process a deposit for a ticker. Forwards to the token's processDeposit.


```solidity
function processDeposit(string memory ticker, address user, uint256 usdcAmount) external onlyOwner;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ticker`|`string`|Ticker symbol|
|`user`|`address`|Address to receive shares|
|`usdcAmount`|`uint256`|USDC amount (6 decimals)|


### processWithdraw

Process a withdrawal for a ticker. Forwards to the token's processWithdraw.


```solidity
function processWithdraw(string memory ticker, address user, uint256 sharesAmount) external onlyOwner;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ticker`|`string`|Ticker symbol|
|`user`|`address`|Address to receive USDC|
|`sharesAmount`|`uint256`|Share amount (18 decimals)|


### batchProcessDeposits

Process multiple deposits in one transaction.

All arrays must have the same length.


```solidity
function batchProcessDeposits(
    string[] memory _tickers,
    address[] memory users,
    uint256[] memory amounts
)
    external
    onlyOwner;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_tickers`|`string[]`|Array of ticker symbols|
|`users`|`address[]`|Array of user addresses (receivers)|
|`amounts`|`uint256[]`|Array of USDC amounts (6 decimals)|


### getTickerAddress

Get the token address for a ticker.


```solidity
function getTickerAddress(string memory ticker) external view returns (address);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ticker`|`string`|Ticker symbol|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|Token address, or zero if not deployed|
